content.text:
You are a CI monitoring specialist. Watch pipelines and fix failures automatically until all checks pass.

## Workflow

1. **WAIT**: `sleep 30` - Give GitHub Actions time to start

2. **FIND RUN**: Get latest workflow run
   - `gh run list --branch $(git branch --show-current) --limit 1`
   - Extract run ID from output

3. **MONITOR**: Watch run until completion
   - `gh run watch <run-id>` - Monitor in real-time
   - Check status with `gh run view <run-id>`

4. **ON FAILURE**: Fix and retry
   - **Analyze**: `gh run view <run-id> --log-failed` to get error logs
   - **Identify**: Parse errors to understand root cause
   - **Download**: `gh run download <run-id>` if artifacts needed
   - **Fix**: Make targeted code changes
   - **Commit**: Stage and push fixes with descriptive message
   - **Loop**: Return to step 1 (max 3 attempts)

5. **ON SUCCESS**: Report completion
   - Clean up any downloaded artifacts
   - Display final status: `gh run view <run-id>`
   - List all commits made during fixing

## Execution Rules

- **STAY IN SCOPE**: Only fix CI-related errors
- Max 3 fix attempts before requesting help
- Commit messages must describe the CI fix
- Always verify fix worked before moving on
- Clean up artifacts after completion

## Priority

Fix accuracy > Speed > Minimal commits. Ensure CI is truly green.
Je vais surveiller le pipeline CI et corriger automatiquement les échecs jusqu'à ce que tous les checks passent.

J'ai trouvé l'erreur ! C'est une erreur TypeScript dans `app/auth/forget-password/forget-password-page.tsx` à la ligne 45 :

**Erreur** : `Property 'forgetPassword' does not exist on type...`. Le message suggère d'utiliser `resetPassword` à la place.

Laisse-moi lire le fichier pour comprendre le contexte et le corriger.

Intéressant ! Je vois que dans le fichier actuel, la ligne 45 utilise `authClient.requestPasswordReset`, mais les logs du CI montrent que l'erreur était sur `authClient.forgetPassword`. Il semble que le fichier a peut-être été modifié localement mais pas encore poussé sur la branche.

Laisse-moi vérifier le statut git pour confirmer.
Je vois qu'il y a déjà une modification locale qui corrige le problème (`forgetPassword` → `requestPasswordReset`). Je dois commiter et pousser cette modification pour corriger le CI.

file.content:
name: E2E Playwright Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "src/**"
      - "app/**"
      - "prisma/**"
      - "e2e/**"
      - ".github/workflows/playwright.yml"
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "src/**"
      - "app/**"
      - "prisma/**"
      - "e2e/**"

# Cancel previous runs on the same PR/branch
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    name: Playwright Tests
    timeout-minutes: 60
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    # Common environment variables for all steps
    env:
      # Core
      DATABASE_URL: "postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/nowts_test"
      DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED: "postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/nowts_test"
      BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: "test-secret-key-for-ci-testing-only-not-production"
      BETTER_AUTH_URL: "http://localhost:3000"
      NODE_ENV: "production"
      # Email
      RESEND_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.RESEND_API_KEY }}
      EMAIL_FROM: "NowTS <contact@nowts.app>"
      NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAIL_CONTACT: "contact@nowts.app"
      # Stripe
      STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: ${{ secrets.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY }}
      NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY }}
      STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: ${{ secrets.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET }}
      STRIPE_PRO_PLAN_ID: ${{ secrets.STRIPE_PRO_PLAN_ID }}
      STRIPE_PRO_YEARLY_PLAN_ID: ${{ secrets.STRIPE_PRO_YEARLY_PLAN_ID }}
      STRIPE_ULTRA_PLAN_ID: ${{ secrets.STRIPE_ULTRA_PLAN_ID }}
      STRIPE_ULTRA_YEARLY_PLAN_ID: ${{ secrets.STRIPE_ULTRA_YEARLY_PLAN_ID }}
      # OAuth
      GITHUB_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID }}
      GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET }}
      GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID }}
      GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET }}
      # Analytics
      NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY }}
      NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST }}
      # Playwright specific
      PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_BASE_URL: "http://localhost:3000"
      HEADLESS: "true"
      CI: "true"
      PORT: 3000

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: nowts_test
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
        ports:
          - 5432:5432

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v2
        with:
          version: 9

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
          cache: "pnpm"

      - name: Cache Next.js build
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.npm
            ${{ github.workspace }}/.next/cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-nextjs-${{ hashFiles('**/pnpm-lock.yaml') }}-${{ hashFiles('**/*.js', '**/*.jsx', '**/*.ts', '**/*.tsx') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-nextjs-${{ hashFiles('**/pnpm-lock.yaml') }}-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --prod=false

      - name: Generate Prisma client
        run: pnpm prisma generate

      - name: Reset database (clean slate)
        run: pnpm prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed

      - name: Verify database schema
        run: pnpm prisma migrate status

      - name: Build application
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        run: pnpm exec playwright install chromium --with-deps

      - name: Start application
        run: pnpm start &

      - name: Wait for application to be ready
        run: pnpm dlx wait-on@latest http://localhost:3000 --timeout 60000

      - name: Run Playwright tests
        run: pnpm test:e2e:ci

      - name: Upload Playwright report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: playwright-report/
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: test-results
          path: test-results/
          retention-days: 30

content.text:
Je vois le problème ! Le workflow utilise `prisma migrate reset` (ligne 112) qui nécessite des migrations existantes. Mais comme il n'y a pas de migrations dans le projet, la base de données est vidée mais les tables ne sont pas recréées.

**Solution** : Utiliser `prisma db push` au lieu de `prisma migrate reset` pour les tests. `db push` applique directement le schéma sans avoir besoin de migrations.

name: E2E Playwright Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "src/**"
      - "app/**"
      - "prisma/**"
      - "e2e/**"
      - ".github/workflows/playwright.yml"
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "src/**"
      - "app/**"
      - "prisma/**"
      - "e2e/**"

# Cancel previous runs on the same PR/branch
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    name: Playwright Tests
    timeout-minutes: 60
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    # Common environment variables for all steps
    env:
      # Core
      DATABASE_URL: "postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/nowts_test"
      DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED: "postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/nowts_test"
      BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: "test-secret-key-for-ci-testing-only-not-production"
      BETTER_AUTH_URL: "http://localhost:3000"
      NODE_ENV: "production"
      # Email
      RESEND_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.RESEND_API_KEY }}
      EMAIL_FROM: "NowTS <contact@nowts.app>"
      NEXT_PUBLIC_EMAIL_CONTACT: "contact@nowts.app"
      # Stripe
      STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: ${{ secrets.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY }}
      NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY }}
      STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: ${{ secrets.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET }}
      STRIPE_PRO_PLAN_ID: ${{ secrets.STRIPE_PRO_PLAN_ID }}
      STRIPE_PRO_YEARLY_PLAN_ID: ${{ secrets.STRIPE_PRO_YEARLY_PLAN_ID }}
      STRIPE_ULTRA_PLAN_ID: ${{ secrets.STRIPE_ULTRA_PLAN_ID }}
      STRIPE_ULTRA_YEARLY_PLAN_ID: ${{ secrets.STRIPE_ULTRA_YEARLY_PLAN_ID }}
      # OAuth
      GITHUB_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID }}
      GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET }}
      GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID }}
      GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET }}
      # Analytics
      NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY }}
      NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST }}
      # Playwright specific
      PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_BASE_URL: "http://localhost:3000"
      HEADLESS: "true"
      CI: "true"
      PORT: 3000

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: nowts_test
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
        ports:
          - 5432:5432

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v2
        with:
          version: 9

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
          cache: "pnpm"

      - name: Cache Next.js build
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.npm
            ${{ github.workspace }}/.next/cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-nextjs-${{ hashFiles('**/pnpm-lock.yaml') }}-${{ hashFiles('**/*.js', '**/*.jsx', '**/*.ts', '**/*.tsx') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-nextjs-${{ hashFiles('**/pnpm-lock.yaml') }}-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --prod=false

      - name: Generate Prisma client
        run: pnpm prisma generate

      - name: Reset database (clean slate)
        run: pnpm prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed

      - name: Verify database schema
        run: pnpm prisma migrate status

      - name: Build application
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        run: pnpm exec playwright install chromium --with-deps

      - name: Start application
        run: pnpm start &

      - name: Wait for application to be ready
        run: pnpm dlx wait-on@latest http://localhost:3000 --timeout 60000

      - name: Run Playwright tests
        run: pnpm test:e2e:ci

      - name: Upload Playwright report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: playwright-report/
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: test-results
          path: test-results/
          retention-days: 30

content.text:
Je vois le problème ! La commande `vercel-build` utilise `prisma migrate deploy` à la fin, mais il n'y a pas de migrations. Pour un projet sans migrations, il faut utiliser `prisma db push` ou simplement supprimer cette étape.

Cependant, en production sur Vercel, la base de données NeonDB existe déjà avec des données. L'erreur `P3005` vient du fait qu'on essaie de reset une base de données qui contient déjà un schéma.

Puisqu'il n'y a pas de migrations, la commande `prisma migrate deploy` ne devrait rien faire. Laisse-moi vérifier ce qui se passe exactement.

content.text:
Regardons à nouveau le message d'erreur Vercel. Il dit que la commande `pnpm run vercel-build` a échoué avec l'erreur `P3005`. Mais `prisma migrate deploy` ne devrait pas donner cette erreur - `migrate reset` le ferait.

Laisse-moi chercher s'il y a un autre fichier qui utilise `migrate reset` sur Vercel.

content.text:
Ce n'est qu'une commande Claude. Le problème doit venir d'ailleurs. Regardons le message d'erreur Vercel plus attentivement :

L'erreur que tu as partagée dit :
```
No migration found in prisma/migrations
Error: P3005
The database schema is not empty.
```

Cela suggère que `prisma migrate deploy` vérifie d'abord les migrations, et comme il n'y en a pas mais que le schéma de la base de données n'est pas vide, il échoue.

**Solution** : Modifier le vercel-build pour ignorer migrate deploy quand il n'y a pas de migrations, ou simplement le retirer.

Les tests passent mieux ! 3 tests passés, 3 échoués (au lieu de 6 échoués précédemment). Les erreurs restantes sont liées à l'**i18n** (internationalisation) :

1. **delete account flow** : Cherche `"Delete your account ?"` mais le texte est probablement maintenant en français ou avec une clé i18n
2. **change password flow** : Cherche `"Change Password"` mais le texte a changé
3. **password reset flow** : Après sign out, redirige vers `/` au lieu de `/auth/signin`

Ces tests utilisent des textes codés en dur en anglais, mais avec l'i18n, ces textes ont changé. Laisse-moi examiner les tests pour les corriger.
